# optSolver

> Rust library (crate `optsolver`) that solves linear, convex quadratic and conic optimisation
> problems held in matrix form (compressed sparse column) through Gurobi and MOSEK, borrowing
> the caller's arrays without copying, with one solver-independent problem, options and result
> type and independent verification of every solution.

## Docs

- [Interface document](llm-interface.md): everything needed to add the dependency and write
  correct client code (problem model, zero-copy input rules, backends and capabilities,
  options, statuses, solution sign conventions, certificates, verification, errors, threading,
  complete compiled examples). Start here.
- [Test corpus](test-corpus.md): the committed test problems, including small self-contained
  toy instances for every problem class and cone type.
- [README](../README.md): build commands, features, test tiers.
